reasons.claim: Two eligible (threatened, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) fungi recorded within 250 m: Tricholoma apium (VU, 0 m, 2022) and Hydnellum scabrosum (VU, 210 m, 2022); both list lack of continuity forest, lack of old/large trees and soil disturbance in forestry as threats.
Seven site-bound forest NT species within 250 m, most at 0 m (e.g. Sarcodon squamosus, Hydnellum ferrugineum, Ramaria eosanguinea), all 2022 records with 10 m uncertainty.
Completed felling overlaps only 0.5% of the polygon (2007), so it is not already felled. The 12.36 ha regeneration felling was notified 2026-09-28.
Recording effort is adequate (665 records within 1000 m, county median 42; 155 records within 250 m over 6 days), so the records reflect real attention to the site.

uncertainties: Records are from 2022 (one vascular plant 2024); current occupancy of the felling site is unknown.
Fungal fruiting records show where fruiting bodies were seen, not the extent of mycelium.
Records are mostly from a single year, possibly one survey visit (6 observation days within 250 m).
not_established: Whether the felling would harm these species.
Legality of the felling or legal protection of the species (Red List category is extinction risk only).
That the stand is old or continuity forest; tools do not state it.
next_action: Refer for human ecological review before felling starts: check the 2022 VU fungus records (Tricholoma apium at 0 m) against the polygon boundary and consider a field inventory.
